content.user_title: Apply Cohesive Themes to Slides and Artifacts
content.value_statement: Designing slides and documents often wastes time when colors and fonts drift across pages. Theme Factory gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code reusable palettes, typography pairings, and a review flow for applying consistent themes.
actual_capabilities: Presents ten preset themes with names, descriptions, palettes, fonts, and best-use guidance.
Guides users to review the local theme-showcase.pdf before choosing a theme.
Applies selected theme colors and fonts consistently to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Reads theme specifications from the themes directory when a preset is chosen.
Creates a custom theme name, palette, and font pairing when presets do not fit.
limitations: It provides design instructions; actual artifact editing depends on host tool access.
It does not automatically run accessibility or contrast tests.
It has ten preset themes before custom theme generation.
The showcase PDF must be viewable in the user environment.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Presentation Deck
use_cases.description: Apply one visual system across an existing deck so slides share colors, typography, and tone.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Reports
use_cases.description: Use a professional theme to make reports, dashboards, and supporting documents feel consistent.

use_cases.title: Create a New Visual Direction
use_cases.description: Generate a custom theme when the ten presets do not match the brand or audience.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase, ask me to choose one preset, then apply the selected theme to my slide deck.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Business Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this presentation, recommend two built-in themes for an executive audience, and explain the tradeoffs before applying my choice.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Multiple Artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use one visual direction across my slides, report, and landing page. Choose a preset theme, then adapt emphasis for each format.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a custom theme from my brand notes, propose a name, palette, and font pairing, then apply it after my approval.

output_examples.input: I selected Ocean Depths for a consulting deck.
output_examples.output: A deck updated with navy, teal, seafoam, and cream accents plus DejaVu Sans headings and body text.

output_examples.input: None of the presets match our healthcare product launch.
output_examples.output: A custom theme proposal with a calm name, accessible medical colors, matching fonts, and approval before application.

output_examples.input: Apply one theme to slides and a matching HTML landing page.
output_examples.output: Both artifacts use the same palette and typography, with layout adjustments for each medium.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a theme for an important artifact.
Choose themes based on audience, content tone, and readability needs.
Ask for approval before applying a custom theme across many files.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme before the user confirms the selected direction.
Do not mix multiple preset palettes in one artifact without a clear reason.
Do not sacrifice contrast or readability for decorative color choices.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply consistent colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with a palette, font pairing, description, and best-use guidance.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose a custom theme name, colors, and fonts from the user brief.

faq.question: Does it edit files by itself?
faq.answer: It guides the host assistant. Actual editing depends on the files and tools available in the session.

faq.question: Is the showcase PDF required?
faq.answer: The PDF helps users compare themes visually, but the theme markdown files contain the usable specifications.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
